messages:
maria-sales: Quick thread — MediSure POC goes live tomorrow AM. They asked for a short capacity + pricing sketch we can attach to the SOW. Traffic profile: expected peak ~1k RPS, 95th QPS ~800, avg tokens per request (prompt+resp) ~70, typical chat (no long-context). They want HIPAA support (we're on Private), and curious about reserved GPUs vs burst credits: what min reserved should we quote, and what autoscale min/max/burst config makes sense?

ashwin-eng: thanks — quick calc: at 70 tokens/request and aiming for 1k RPS that's 70k tokens/s. With current throughput numbers (redwood-3-medium quantized) we get ~13k tokens/s per GPU on average under mixed latency constraints. So rough reserved = ceil(70k / 13k) = 6 GPUs.

ashwin-eng: caveats: this assumes continuous steady 1k RPS. If peak is spiky we should reserve 4 GPUs and rely on burst credits + autoscale to 8 for short windows. That gives a safety buffer.

lee-ml: also consider model variant — if they accept a quantized variant we can push ~16k tok/s per GPU which drops reserved to 5 or even 4 with caching. If they require full precision, plan for +20-30% capacity.

ashwin-eng: KV/prefix caching note: since it's chat, enabling prefix KV cache will reduce tokens generated per request for followups. Recommend enabling KV warmup during preheat. Operationally that reduces observed tokens/s by ~10-25% depending on conversation branching.

maria-sales: good — can you put that as two options so I can show pricing: (A) conservative reserved = 6 GPUs, autoscale 6->8 with burst credits; (B) cost-optimized = 4 reserved, autoscale 4->8 with preheat & quantized model.

fin-bot: billing note: internal list rates (DO NOT SHARE externally) — reserved GPU seat: $3.25/hr; burst credit pool ops cost estimate: $0.90/hr equivalent for short bursts depending on duration. Monthly example: Option A ~6 * 24 * 30 * 3.25 = $14,040/mo base. Option B base = 4 * 24 * 30 * 3.25 = $9,360/mo + expected burst spend variable.

ashwin-eng: autoscale policy suggestion: min_reserved = 4 (if option B) or 6 (option A), max = 8, scale policy: cpu/qps target window 30s, scale-up immediate on queue growth >20% over window, cool-down 2m. Queue depth target < 50ms additional per-request latency.

lee-ml: also propose fallback: if quantized model quality regressions > threshold on eval prompts, route to full-precision variant in a canary pool (smaller capacity) to avoid user-facing errors. Adds small cost but avoids regressions.

sami-security: HIPAA checklist note — Private deployment is required and we need KMS/HSM keys in customer tenancy, plus an executed BAA. Also ask MediSure to complete our security questionnaire section 3.2 (data retention & logging). Link: https://redwood.internal/security/questionnaire/medisure (internal).

maria-sales: Sami — are there any capacity constraints for Private environments (we're hosting them in eu-west-1)? They asked about AZ spread and spot eviction tolerance.

sami-security: Private infra note: we can configure AZ affinity, but reserve plan with 6 GPUs should include AZ spread (2/2/2) if they care about availability. Spot/eviction: prefer reserved or dedicated, avoid spot for HIPAA unless customer accepts variable capacity.

olivia-se: I'll own the runbook and ops handoff. Next steps I propose: 1) attach Option A/B pricing + monthly example to SOW, 2) send security questionnaire link, 3) schedule a 30m smoke test with preheat scripts to validate actual tokens/s. I'll create the deploy ticket and post preheat checklist.

olivia-se: preheat checklist snippet: ```
# preheat steps
1. run kv-warmup for top 100 prefixes
2. precompile kernels for seq_len 512
3. run 10m load test at 200 rps per GPU
4. collect latency + token/s metrics
```

maria-sales: perfect. can someone confirm we can get a short cost estimate PDF by EOD for sales to attach? MediSure legal is waiting on pricing + BAA to proceed.

fin-bot: I'll generate a draft cost sheet and drop in the deal folder. Olivia — assign the ticket to me for final rates.

deploy-bot: smoke test slot booked: 2024-06-12T21:00Z -> /infra/smoke-tests/1718005555. Ops oncall: @ashwin-eng.

ashwin-eng: I'll run the preheat tomorrow morning and post results here. If smoke looks good we'll recommend Option B to save costs but will state the 6-GPU conservative plan in the SOW.

maria-sales: thanks everyone — this is actionable. I'll update the SOW with both options and attach the security questionnaire link. Will ping again after the smoke results. :thumbsup:
